triggers: pin the tail on the pony
lore.text: Pin the Tail on the Pony is a classic Equestrian party game. A poster of a pony missing her tail hangs on the west wall of Sugarcube Corner, with a basket of yarn tails and a chalk scoreboard beside it. The player is blindfolded, spun around, and tries to pin a tail on the gold X where the tail belongs; the scoreboard keeps the best shot in centimetres. Onlookers traditionally call out warmer or colder, and laugh along when a tail lands somewhere silly.
